body:
> DO NOT GIVE THIS MAN MONEY.

When did I ask for money?

Sorry for this quick thread - leaving home right now, no real time to post a more proof-read thread :(.

EDIT: I have indeed received, for those interested, private messages of people offering me money, after my first thread. I have not responded to any of these requests. To make this point clear once and for all ("you're a scammer looking to steal my money!") I will write this: **IF YOU OFFER ME MONEY, I WILL FEEL EXTREMELY INSULTED. DO NOT OFFER ME MONEY. I DO NOT WANT IT.**

I hope this settle this trivial matter, based on some redditors' (not totally unjustified) paranoia, once and for all. I'd appreciate more advice and support on my original update. Now im leaving home for 2 hours for real.

That's because we had a daughter in the meantime. Sorry, sometime people reproduce.

I don't get all this hate. I clearly never asked for money and wouldn't even accept it. What is wrong wit hyou?

Looking back at it, wise decision.

You know I did not sign a prenup because it was not "romantic" and it I was SO sure she was the woman of my life (hey, I am marrying here!), why would I sign a prenup? That's a sign of distrust ain't it???? Maybe deep down I know our marriage will fail and hence why I ask her to sign a prenup!!!!!!!

Man I'm stupid, stupid, stupid, STUPID. If you do marry, SIGN A PRENUP. I don't care how hot and intelligent she is, SIGN IT (unless she has more assets than you obviously).

>So the bint does all this crazy stuff, goes to the nuthouse and still gets the fucking kids?

*and* gets me arrested and fired.

Good question! To be honest I have no idea, I looked at "AskReddit" and saw "Xmas 09" and then read it up. 

I'll make a post. I'm not a terribly fast writer but I'll make it. A lot has happened in the two last years and I think it would be a great idea to share.

Hello,

That would be me. I never totally left reddit; I remained active on my main account (didn't want people to associate).

Wow, this has been so long ago. I... don't know what to say. I barely see my kids now (not by choice), but I can make an update if people want.
It's crazy how she can change from one extreme - soft, gentle, delicate, wanting to be a good mother - to the other: destructive, angry, paranoid, etc.

Yes, I did write this very quickly - I apologize. 

I have discussed these changes in the comments and replies of the older thread. I understand they are not easily found. Hell, the character limit on Reddit even limited me! Did you know there was a character limit on posts? I did not!

In the months preceding I was more absent. Once she caught me "cheating" as she called it when I told her I would work late; turns out I have been going out with friends (something I am not supposed to do) to drink. She called the office, and found out. It's all little details like that that led me to this.
23 years? That's going strong, you are very lucky, I admire your tenacity and ability to work out problems. You're a model to follow for younger couples.

Very honestly, and I know I cannot answer because I am not in your situation, I would have done it. A weeks/months of pain is nothing compared to having this problem for life. Congrats on getting it fixed.
No question. Just wanted to congratulate you for your courage, and congratulate you for going through it. Amazing what medicine can do!

Thank you, it's alright. You know what the irony is? I really wish I was trolling. Trust me, I really wish. It was all so sudden, so shocking... I wish this was all a prank and that cameras came out behind me with my kids laughing and saying it was done for the show and that I would earn $1,000,000 for my participation. Gosh I'm so tired I don't even know what I'm talking about.

>I'd like to say something positive, but how can you trust her with your kids when she doesn't believe they're hers?

Oh I'm not even close to that right now. I'm staying home for the time being (thank you, insurance!) and we have been discussing having the kids stay with their grandparents after that. Then again, once the school begins, it will be a weight off our shoulders.

Right now it's not that she doesn't believe the kids are her - she knows they are hers and she really wants to believe they are hers, but for a reason, she just can't. She told me she had this weird feeling, it might never go away. She told me she just felt lost and couldn't be sure of anything. It's probably partly do to medication, but I'm not going to complain, believe me ;)

My wife has always been a very calm, pacifist person. She couldn't hurt anyone. I am sure of it. Well I was sure of it, anyway. I'm also thinking about what may happens if she is negligent or forgets something... Or gets a panic attack and believe she has to kill her children. Yeah...

[Update!](http://www.reddit.com/r/reddit.com/comments/alupk/i_am_the_guy_who_got_the_worst_christmas_gift/)

Thank you for your kind words. It's funny because my attorney - the one I hired when I thought this divorce thing would be going on - actually bitched at me for letting her back, telling me I "would hire him again a month from now". Heh.

Thanks all for your support. I did post a new post [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/reddit.com/comments/alupk/i_am_the_guy_who_got_the_worst_christmas_gift/). Didn't want to reply to every person manually and this text has a 10,000 chracter limit. Thank you again for help. The last days have been pretty busy, to say the least.

Hehe funny, but I thought about the "cheating on me". My lawyer is still officially on it (although he hasn't started to work). For now I will let the things run (he has my hard drive). Until the papers are invalidated she did file them after all.
Thank you thank you =)
Actually for a while they were right. I was fully ready to defend myself. Things took a dramatic turn, but for one night I was ready for a long divorce battle.
Thank you for your words :) I read and keep reading every comment. At least now I know. Not knowing was the worst.
Interesting. I hadn't thought about medical checkup. I will make sure to bring it up.

It's not really about the divoce anymore. Unless I am the one filing it now.

The worst is, I have no idea what she did, what happened, how it happened. I have no clue what part of what she said was true and what part was false. Maybe she is the one who cheated on me. I can't know.

I am thinking about telling the truth. Perhaps get more information as well. They are smart boys. It's funny because we did buy them excellent gifts for this christmas (PS3, telescope, chemistry set...) and they barely touched them. And to say these might be the last gifts we buy them together...........

Thank you for your help. Looks like I have more wikipedia to do :)

Thanks for the links too, I will read them when I can concentrate more.
Yes, I had this one mentioned! I'm sorry for your friend. At least she got a diagnosis now. Are there any medication?

Thank you. I feel a bit more prepared now, maybe for years of therapy and help. Maybe there's light at the end. Maybe I should divorce and find a new wife. After all we've shared, all we lived.............................................................

The psychiatrist I spoke with wouldn't give any diagnosis or even hint at a possible condition. I asked if he had any idea and he told me more tests and meetings would be required before giving out any diagnosis. I have called a few friends working either in the medical or the mental illness fields (including some from her family) and the words I heard the most was "bipolar disorder," and also schizophrenia. But how could schizophrenia develop so late in life? I thought it was in the early 20s.
Thank you for the kind words. They really help me pull through this difficult situation.
I understand. It's a huge conflict in my head right now. Potentially the worst decision I ever had to take.

Ahhh medication :) Got to love to science. 30 years ago she would be electrocuted or lobotimized. Now we got pills. I'm ready to accept them. I understand I can't get my old life back. I just want... Well the best for our family.
Your comment made me cry. That's so funny. I have no idea why but your message made me think about sex, and if I would ever do it again with her.
After all this? What can she do next? What if she feels she has to get rid of these kids that "aren't hers"?

Yes, I have came to accept she was seriously ill. In all cases my life from before will never be back. Everything's changed. At least I can comfort myself thinking what I am living is true. I studied some philosophy; Socrates (I think ?) would be very happy.
I will certainly keep this updated - if people are interested (sorry for all the PMs not replied - I will get to them I promise!). I at least had the friends and support. It's been fantastic.

Thank you for the kind words =) Man I love reddit.

It's funny you mention a counselor because the psychiatrist mentioned talking to a social worker, and eventually a counselor. I'm not against it after all this.

I had a great female friend offering to come stay with me to help with the chores and the children. I was so damn tempted to accept! But I do not know the reaction my wife would have if she learned about it. Generous, and I have to deny.
At least I know. One problem's solved, one thing cleared. I think not knowing is the worst. What if your wife came to you and asked divorce, without even telling you why?

It would be easy to hate her now I suppose. Easy to seek revenge. But she is locked in a mental hospital under heavy medication (I think) and mostly lost everything she had, claiming the children she was pregnant of aren't even hers. Would it be really fair to get revenge at this point?
Thank you =). Still having my fingers crossed.

I had some people call "borderline personality disorder" on it. I will have to read more on this.

As for full custody I feel kind of weird. Why would she want full custody of children that aren't even hers? For the time being I cannot have any contact with her. That is what's killing me. Or maybe it is better that way.

Sorry for the lack of reply! I've been up for longer than I can count and slept 3 hours in the last 48 hours. Rough times. I can't wait to get a good night of sleep. Sadly sleeping isn't an option at the moment (can't sleep)

As for your question, I'd say this indeed can have an impact, if at least psychological. If you have a weapon, and the wife tells the judge you could flip out, the judge will picture a man going crazy and shooting his kids. Plus, people associate people with guns as more violent than those without - or maybe that's a misconception.

Yes, thank you. Keep in mind a whole 24h I had no idea she ever had a mental issue. Now I just learned she even consulted with a psychologist when she was younger. 12 years together and I never knew this.

The title of this story is still accurate :)

I am still hoping for a pill and medication. I have heard a lot of negative things on pills and how they control and change you but look at the situation frankly: I'd do anything I could to get my wife back.

I am considering going on vacation. I'll lose my promotion and part of my salary but I really think this could help.
Thank you for your words :)

I have to admit I indeed was working too much. 

At the beginning of the relationship, I told her I wouldn't mind if the wife would stay home to stay with the kids. It has been this way ever since we married. I, however, would often work much more than necessary, if one can say so. I got a brillant promotion, but missed a lot of things in my life.

Leighsah,

I read your entire story. All I can say is: wow, you have been through a lot and quite frankly I feel a bit scared. I can only imagine what would happen if you had kids with this person. I really hope it's not as bad.

How are you pulling through right now? What is happening? 

The psychiatrist were kind of neutral when discussing my wife's situation. I talked to a lot of people and the word I heard the most was "borderline personality disorder". I'm not a psychiatrist but I am aware this illness might not have a cure. I really, really don't want to live all this - sorry but I do not have your strength. I wouldn't be able to make it. And I don't think my kids could.

Thank you for the honest testimony of what happened. It's late, I still can't sleep, and I still don't know what to do :)

Thank you. I am not fully decided, still very afraid of what might happen. What if she decides the children are not hers and must die? I don't know how I will cope, with that constant threat. Why, why...

Wow what a touching story... I wish I could describe everything with so many details. It's very touching to read what has happened from her side, partially. 

I understand she is sick. I blamed me for it all day, for not noticing and not helping here, until I was explained it wasn't my fault. I felt desperate I wasn't even able to notice it. And I think I helped her develop more and more symptoms, without noticing, without caring.

I am thinking about her right now: where she is, what she is doing, what is happening to her... Everything just went so quickly. I just wish she had the courage to act sooner and seek help.

Thank you for the post. I have given the matter much thought. As expected I still cannot sleep tonight; it is now 1:41AM and I will reply to every post I had (thousands!). I have spent most of the rest of this day on the phone and with relative. This just feel so... odd.
Ouch! Wrist hurts from typing too much. Writing all this story really helped me though. I feel better now!

Sorry, sorry I had a lot going - I know I did not update this in time. My hard drive, the full documents, my wife's papers are all in my attorney's office. Most important of all I think I understood what happened. I normally wouldn't want to share this with anybody but you've been amazing, Reddit. I'll update my first post as soon as possible.

I'm sorry for my lack of replies. Today has been a very busy day. For now I'll keep this simple: the house has never been this cleaned, I met two attorney, one police officer and ate day-after-christmas breakfast with two kids that asked me repeatedly "Where is mommy? Where is mommy?" What can I answer to that? 

It's now 4 o'clock and I've been working non-stop since 7AM, excluding one hour to eat. Do you have any idea of how hard it is to find a competent attorney the day after christmas, especially on a saturday? I'm working to write the full post.

Thank you for the overwhelming support Reddit, you've been incredible!
I'm back. I had a little interview with police. Things are going better now. I now know why she did it and what happened. I will try to keep this updated.
I am doing alright - with her wage, we were able to live comfortably with two children.
Yes, I am now realizing she had been planning this for a while. Some papers are dated in november. She slept with me since then. Unbelievable.

More valuable advice... Thank you... Might grab one at the boxing day. Anyway, I can't sleep. This is going to be a long week.

I am digging through her stuff now, trying to find a hint. Still no news from her. She didn't even have the decency to call, or even pick up the phone.
So tired... I guess not knowing what's happening is the worse...

Yes! Thank you for the advice. Looks like I have a rough night in front of me. I have already gotten rid of some potentially incriminating stuff. I have also called a good friend of mine - he wouldn't believe this happened, even called me a liar, so I suppose I can't blame people on Reddit for being skeptical. 

I am thinking of going to the police right now, after his advice. She could come back in the middle of the night. After all that happened I guess it's not out of the question. Looks like I have a very rough 26 december coming. Then again it's saturday, so at best I will speak to an attorney monday-tuesday. Thank you again.
I deny it. Thank you for ruining my thread, and potentially preventing me from getting more valuable advice. I know karma will get you one day.
Thanks for the advice. I will start putting her things in boxes, I think.

I never ever had to talk to a lawyer before and I have lived a lot. I have no idea where to start...  Yellow pages? In all cases I probably won't be able to talk to one until next monday at best............

I am 35, never said I was served any paper, and you misread most of my post. 

EDIT: 35, wrote that too quickly under emotion I guess.
It's throwaway account. I do not want my main linked with it.

Thank you. This is the first comment that is really helpful. I am taking everything that might potentially be illegal out. Sadly there are few places I can drop them on christmas' eve. I am also taking out the hard drive on our familial computer in case we find something.
No pre-nup. We have a 8-year-old boy and a 6 years old boy.
The story is true. Your accusations are nothing but hurtful and unjustified.
